Problem statement: species do not always have constant observer effects - relative biomass can mask effects on non-dominant species.

Goal: test a new method to do multivariate analysis on species catches and compare these results to those derived from alternative multivariate and single species or univariate approaches.  We do this over multiple degrees of species interactions (dominance) and degrees of bias (observer effects). 
this is a test

#setup

```{r packages}
library(tidyverse)
```

##combine datasets
```{r}


#bias 25
load("output_data/alltests_2spp_oe25_cov25_set1.Rdata")
r1 <- res_comb
load("output_data/alltests_2spp_oe25_cov25_set2.Rdata")
r2 <- res_comb %>% mutate(set = set + max(r1$set))
res_comb <- bind_rows(r1, r2)
rm(r1, r2); gc() #remove temp objects and clean up
res_oe <- res_comb %>% mutate(effsize = 25)
```

##Summarize delta between planned and acutal BPlevel
```{r}
# drift from target bp
bp <- res_oe %>% mutate(diff_bp = abs(bp_true - bp_level), 
                        pct_diff = 100*diff_bp, 
                        rev = ifelse(sp2 > sp1, 1, 0))
bp_mn <- bp %>% group_by(set) %>% summarize(M = mean(pct_diff))
summary(bp_mn$M)

#incidence of reversed bp
(sum(bp$rev)/nrow(bp))*100
```

##figure: power of all tests for 3 bias levels
```{r}
power_fig_dat <- 
  res_oe %>%
  mutate(t_test_sig = ifelse(tp < 0.05, 1, 0),
           f_test_sig = ifelse(Fp < 0.05, 1, 0),
           glm_mgcv_sig = ifelse(glm_mgcv_p <= 0.05, 1, 0), 
           KS_test_sig = ifelse(KSp < 0.05, 1, 0),
           permu_sig = ifelse(p_val < 0.05, 1, 0), #permutation
           median_test_sig = ifelse(ci_lo > 0 | ci_hi < 0, 1, 0),
           mvglm_sig = ifelse(mvglm_p < 0.05, 1, 0),
           gllvm_sig = ifelse(p_gllvm < 0.05, 1, 0),
           perma_sig = ifelse(perma_p < 0.05, 1, 0), #permanova
           glmm_sig = ifelse(p_glmm < 0.05, 1, 0)
    ) %>%
  group_by(effsize, bp_level) %>%
  summarize(
    across(ends_with("sig"), 
           list(
             pctsig = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
             se     = ~sqrt((mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE) * (1 - mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) / sum(!is.na(.x)))
           ), 
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = contains("_sig_"), 
    names_to = c("Test", ".value"),         # .value tells R to create columns named 'pctsig' and 'se'
    names_pattern = "(.*_sig)_(.*)"        # Regex to split name at the last underscore
  ) %>%
  mutate(Test = factor(Test, 
                       levels = c("t_test_sig", "f_test_sig",
                                  "KS_test_sig","median_test_sig","permu_sig",
                                  "glm_mgcv_sig", "perma_sig", "mvglm_sig", "glmm_sig", "gllvm_sig"),
                       labels = c("t-test", "F test", 
                                  "K-S test", "Median","Permutation", 
                                  "GLM", "PERMANOVA","mvobservr", "glmm", "gllvm"))) %>%
  mutate(effsize = paste0(effsize, " Observer Effect (%)"))

# Make the Figure

# 1. Define the Palette
highlight_colors <- c(
  "grey50",
  "#C0C482",
  "pink",
  "#A9B6C7",
  "black", #"#BAA9C7",
  "#C7A477",
  "#377EB8",  # PERMANOVA (Blue)
  "#E41A1C", # MvGLM (Red)
  "cyan3", #glmmTMB MvGLM
  "violet" #gllvm
)

# 2. The Final Clean Plot
power_plot <- ggplot(power_fig_dat, 
                     aes(x = bp_level, y = pctsig, color = Test, fill = Test)) +
  
  # --- RIBBON LAYER ---
  # Alpha is handled manually here. show.legend = FALSE keeps the legend clean.
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pmax(0, pctsig - (1.96 * se)), 
                  ymax = pmin(1, pctsig + (1.96 * se)),
                  alpha = Test), 
              color = NA, 
              show.legend = FALSE) + 
  
  # --- LINE LAYER ---
  geom_line(aes(linewidth = Test %in% c("mvobservr", "PERMANOVA", "glmm", "gllvm"))) +
  
  # --- POINT LAYER ---
  # Uniform size as requested
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  
  # --- SCALES ---
  scale_color_manual(values = highlight_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = highlight_colors) +
  
  # Ribbon transparency: Background is faint, Focus is visible
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(rep(0.2, 6), 0.4, 0.4, 0.4, 0.4), guide = "none") +
  
  # Line thickness for visual pop
  scale_linewidth_manual(values = c(0.6, 1), guide = "none") + 
  
  # --- FORMATTING ---
  theme_bw() +
  labs(
    x = "Berger-Parker Dominance (%)", 
    y = "Power (Proportion Significant)", 
   # title = "Power Analysis: Multivariate vs. Univariate Performance",
    color = "Test", 
    fill = "Test"
  ) +
  
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent()) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 1)) + 
  facet_wrap(~effsize) +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  ) +
  
  # Simple guide to organize the layout into 2 rows
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE),
         fill = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE))

print(power_plot)

ggsave("figures/Power_by_obseffect_bp_plot.png", power_plot, width = 7, height = 5, units="in", dpi = 300)
```
